notes: ISOLATION of repeat-separation: SIX identical notes at 80 BPM (0.75s each) on ONE comfortable pitch - 'da  da  da  da  da  da', a crisp 'd' between each. No melody, no leaps, so a merge (fewer than 6 notes) is purely the segmenter failing to detect the 'd' closures. Hum a bit louder / closer to the mic than before (both first takes peaked low ~0.15). Replace bpm if you used a different metronome setting.
